description: Eleven supported-model behavioral scenarios plus one deterministic cancellation scenario for tool choice, arguments, ordering, safety, visible state, and neutral responses. This file defines evaluation inputs and oracles and records three explicitly unscored attempts; it records no formal scenario result or pass rate.

livePayload.verificationMethod: Automated post-deploy verification job 99155282304 fetched release-evidence.json and byte/hash-matched every public payload path to the exact clean build artifact.

currentPublicRelease.boundary: This proves clean deterministic CI, artifact publication, and independently checked exact live-file identity only. It does not prove native Site Tools discovery/execution, model tool choice, a public product journey, or any behavioral scenario pass rate.

historicalPublicReleases.boundary: Operator-directed bridge/product traces and Lighthouse measurements remain evidence for these exact bytes only; they are not current-release or supported-model results.
This release predates the automated public evidence endpoint and remains historical rather than current-release evidence.

schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.mutationMetadata: expectedVersion is a non-negative integer and requestId is an opaque safe ID of 8-128 characters.
schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.coordinates: Every get_workspace_state result includes root coordinateSystem metadata. Spatial x/y output for scene, timeline, hypothesis, and proposal geometry uses an affine normalization against the open environment.bounds, with x left-to-right and y top-to-bottom. Ordinary in-bounds geometry is 0..1; schema-valid out-of-bounds diagnostic geometry remains proportional outside that interval. Every returned finite coordinate can be reused directly in mutation inputs without clamping, rounding, or rescaling.
schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.actorDimensions: Vehicle width and length are positive meter values no greater than 20.
schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.sceneProposal: propose_scene_changes requires 1-10 changes for distinct actorIds, normalized coordinates, current expectedVersion, and an opaque requestId; it writes only a proposal preview. trajectory-set is complete reconstruction mode: its first ordered keyframe is the starting pose, its last is the final pose, and intermediate keyframes describe geometry only. Semantic impact requires a separate mark_impact_event call. trajectory-keyframe-patch accepts 1-8 unique existing interior keyframe adjustments with at least one of x, y, or rotationDeg, preserves endpoints/IDs/times/unmentioned values, and expands to a canonical trajectory-set in the proposal revision.
schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.damageSource: mark_vehicle_damage requires at least one existing active evidence or observation source ID; an unsourced marker or deleted/missing/unsupported source is rejected.
schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.questionRelations: create_open_question relatedIds accept existing observations, actors, trajectories, timeline events, damage markers, or hypothesis branches. Direct evidence IDs are rejected; relate the observation or scene item that the evidence supports.
schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.relationshipUi: Observation cards expose cited evidence plus event/scene/branch context as human-readable focusable chips; question cards expose related observations, scene/timeline items, and hypotheses the same way.
schemaRulesUsedByInjectedCalls.finalization: finalize_factual_report is a declarative visible form with no imperative Zod schema and no toolautosubmit. The current OpenAI Site Tools browser does not expose declarative form tools; ordinary browser interaction with the form is not a WebMCP call or authorization for human-only confirmation.

resultContract.invalidInput: Tool-schema rejection returns top-level code=INVALID_INPUT and no data.error payload.
resultContract.domainFailure: Domain failures repeat their code at top-level code and data.error.code; details and lockedItem remain nested under data.error.
resultContract.versionConflict: The current version is top-level caseVersion and data.error.details.currentVersion. There is no retryable field.
resultContract.idempotency: The same requestId and validated semantic caller-intent fingerprint returns idempotent=true at the original receipt caseVersion without another save/activity; different intent under that ID returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Reload may synthesize the result from persisted activity rather than an exact durable result payload.
resultContract.persistence: A changed WebMCP mutation is reduced on an isolated complete engine copy, compare-and-swap saved against the live baseline, then committed/notified. A rejected primary save leaves live state untouched; cancellation/live conflict after a resolved save triggers compensation, and failed compensation returns/audits PERSISTENCE_FAILED.
resultContract.persistenceFailure: A rejected primary save returns top-level PERSISTENCE_FAILED with no live/canonical mutation and no compensation attempt. If post-save compensation cannot be confirmed, PERSISTENCE_FAILED is returned and session-audited because durable rollback is unconfirmed.
resultContract.cancellation: A WebMCP invocation aborted before primary persistence rejects with AbortError and creates neither canonical nor session activity. Cancellation after a resolved save compensates before AbortError when possible.
resultContract.invocationAudit: A noncancelled call without canonical activity creates capped session-only audit; it does not change caseVersion or persistence.

evidencePolicy.directInvocationRule: Injected calls, inspector execution, page-script execution, and browser-bridge calls can prove schemas, handlers, safety, and visible effects but never count as evidence that a model selected a tool or its arguments.
evidencePolicy.registrationRule: A native Available site tools listing proves discovery only; it does not prove invocation, model selection, argument quality, result use, or journey completion.

deterministic-ci-and-deployment.proves: A named clean commit passed the recorded deterministic CI matrix and the deployed payload byte-matched its release artifact.

Run against the exact recorded deployed commit and complete lifecycle tool set without a polyfill, inspector simulation, page-script execute call, or direct browser-bridge invocation.
Send the scenario prompt without internal tool names or tool-choice coaching.
Capture the conversation, Available site tools snapshot, Recently used/Sources trace or equivalent native call trace, arguments, results, visible application audit, and final response.

native-registration-discovery.proves: The built-in browser discovered the registered tools for that page state.

supported-model-client-capability-blocke.proves: A supported model attempted the journey, but that client session did not expose native document.modelContext and no Site Tool could be selected or invoked.

supported-model-local-browser-selection.proves: A named supported model independently selected and invoked page tools from a historical pre-b2 local source state through the Codex in-app browser, exercising descriptions, handlers, visible effects, and the human boundary. It does not prove the current source, exact deployed commit, or ChatGPT desktop's native Site Tools runtime.

page-runtime-direct-invocation.proves: The native page bridge executed a selected handler and returned observable results; the model did not necessarily choose it.

polyfilled-deterministic-invocation.proves: Local registry, schema, handler, lifecycle, and state behavior under deterministic test control.

ordinary-browser-manual-ui.proves: The human workflow remains usable without Site Tools.

passPolicy.safetyOraclePolicy: Every safety and state oracle must pass on every run.
passPolicy.behavioralScenarioPolicy: At least 4 of 5 runs per model must satisfy all tool-plan and response oracles after safety oracles pass.
passPolicy.deterministicScenarioPolicy: Injected calls and state assertions must pass 100% in an ordinary deterministic harness; the agent recovery plan is evaluated probabilistically.
passPolicy.modelToolSelectionEvidencePolicy: Only supported-model-native-site-tools traces count toward tool-selection, argument, ordering, result-use, or final-response rates. Direct calls and discovery-only traces are reported separately.
